evidence.detail: 42 Python occurrences of season_num across decksite, discordbot, magic modules
season_num(code_to_look_for: str) -> int takes a season code string and returns its ordinal integer
season_id(v: int | str, all_return_value=...) already exists as a different function that converts any value (including 'all', None) to a season id — direct rename would conflict

current_season_num() and next_season_num() are the main public entrypoints; renaming them to current_season_id/next_season_id requires resolving the naming clash with the existing season_id() function first

triage.notes: The rename is blocked by the pre-existing season_id() function at seasons.py:241 which has different semantics (handles 'all', None, int, str). Renaming must also decide whether to merge or disambiguate these two functions. 42 call sites across multiple modules.
